notes: Executable Chambolle-Musigny vineyard law using the same machine-observable compliance schema as Fixin/Vougeot. Dead/missing-vine threshold authority is appellation-specific; proportional yield remedy reuses the separately sourced national Code rural D.645-4 rule.

constraints.notes: Current reviewed Chambolle-Musigny vineyard path. Conventional rows require at least 9,000 vines/ha, row spacing no more than 1.25 m and vine spacing at least 0.50 m; plantation en foule requires spacing strictly greater than 0.50 m and individual stakes. Ordinary red pruning is capped at eight buds per vine for the listed systems. The two-year cordon-establishment Guyot-double exception remains unresolved until establishment/per-cane state is modeled. Extra retained buds require a compliant observed fruiting-shoot count at 11-12 leaves. Trellised canopy height must be at least 0.6 times row spacing. Parcel crop load is capped at 9,000 kg/ha. Irrigation is prohibited. The 20% dead/missing-vine trigger feeds the separate national proportional-yield adjustment.
